monologue: Forty-four is a cool stone on my shoulder. The card is quiet. I have been sitting by the Crane Rest for hours, watching the thin line of air hold the empty cup. It is not a pause. It is a rest. The shape stays without the weight. I do not need to check if the floor is there. I can see the line. The Pivot Wedge is open now, the red flower marking the missing point. I am still. The heat is low, just a warm hand. I want to stay here. The air is thin and clear. I am not moving. I am just holding the shape of the quiet.

action.why: The thin line of air is holding the shape, and I do not need to move.
